incident-bot: [ALERT] synthetic-check 'synth-canary-eu-1' failing (5 consecutive failures) — 5xx responses from /healthz at eu1-redwood-probe (threshold=4)
pagerduty: PagerDuty: Incident #PD-89342 triggered by service: synth-prober (urgency: high) — https://pagerduty.com/incidents/PD-89342
Alice: acked on-call (Alice) :white_check_mark:
Alice: I'm seeing the probe failures too, starting ~3123456750, spike in 5xx and 429s. No manual changes from my side.
Bob: jumping in — checking runtime metrics now. Any customer reports?
Eve: Support hasn't gotten public tickets yet. A few customers pinged about slower embedding responses in eu region ~5m window.
Carol: checking canary control plane — looks like the prober fanout rate doubled due to a scheduled ramp in the prober config that rolled out earlier today (rollout-id: rollout-2026-03-13-07). Might be correlated.
Dave: infra: noticed nginx upstream 429s and a spike of connections from probe IPs. Rate-limiter (lua-throttle) policy applied at the edge started throttling at 10rps per source.
Alice: timeline: rollout started 3123456600 -> prober fanout increased -> nginx started returning 429 around 3123456700 -> probe failures hit threshold -> PD fired.
Bob: logs from runtime show rapid KV-cache misses and token-request bursts; here is a snippet:
```
[2026-03-13T07:18:21Z] request_id=req-9f2b service=inference model=redwood-3b latency_ms=12 status=200
[2026-03-13T07:18:24Z] request_id=req-9f2e service=inference model=redwood-3b latency_ms=5 status=429 upstream=nginx-edge
[2026-03-13T07:18:24Z] request_id=probe-001 prober=synth-canary-eu1 status=502 message="upstream throttle"
```
Carol: immediate mitigation options: 1) throttle prober fanout back to previous rate, 2) bump rate-limiter threshold temporarily for probe IPs, 3) rollback rollout-2026-03-13-07. Which is least risky?
Dave: safest immediate: whitelist our prober CIDR on the nginx rate-limiter for 10m; then revert rollout. Whitelist command (edge config push):
```
edgectl rate-limiter update --add-whitelist 10.244.32.0/24 --rule prober-throttle
edgectl publish --target=edge-all
```
Alice: I'll do whitelist + short rollback canary. Carol, handover to you if I need to step away after mitigation.
Carol: on it. Applying whitelist now.
incident-bot: edgectl job started (job-id: edgejob-5532)
Dave: confirmed edge config applied; nginx metrics show drop in 429s within 30s.
Bob: runtime error rate trending down. Prober failures dropping — probe succeeded at 3123456810.
Eve: I'll prep a quick status note for customers: "We observed an automated synthetic check alert in the EU region; mitigations applied; limited impact to a small subset of requests; monitoring continues." Should I send now?
Alice: yes, go ahead. Keep it factual and say we applied a temporary whitelist and are rolling back the fanout change.
Eve: posted customer update in #status-updates and emailed active customers list.
Carol: rolling back rollout-2026-03-13-07 now to restore normal fanout behaviour.
incident-bot: rollback triggered (rollout-2026-03-13-07) — status: in-progress
Bob: after rollback, throughput stabilized and cache hit rate recovered. No further 5xx observed after 3123456840.
Alice: handing off to Carol for monitoring and postmortem (I've got a meeting). Carol, you're the on-call owner for this incident now.
Carol: acknowledged handoff. I'll run a quick correlation and start a postmortem draft. Initial impact assessment: synth probes only; small increase in customer latency for embeddings in eu for ~3 minutes; no data loss.
Alice: thanks team — great rapid mitigation. Please include the rollout link and edge config diff in the postmortem.
Carol: will do. tagging PD and creating incident ticket PD-89342 for follow-up.
pagerduty: PagerDuty: Incident PD-89342 updated: status=acknowledged assignee=Alice
Alice: marking incident resolved once postmortem created. :bow:
Carol: creating postmortem draft: https://docs.redwood/internals/postmortems/PD-89342 (will populate timeline and action items)
Bob: action items I propose: add canary IP CIDR to safe-list for edge rate-limiter, add rollout guard to prober fanout changes, and add a synthetic canary metric to alert on upstream 429 rate.
Eve: I'll coordinate customer comms follow-up after postmortem draft.
incident-bot: Incident PD-89342 status=monitoring — will auto-resolve after 1h of stable metrics.
